scope: Static gfx1151 compiler and ISA evidence only; no GPU execution, numerical result or performance measurement
candidate_schedule: The loop waits for its previous loads, copies those six data registers, issues the next b128 activation/b64 weight loads, then executes four FMA mix instructions in component order 3,1,2,0 before the scalar loop backedge. Prefetch overlaps those FMAs/backedge; it does not remove every wait.
geometry: 320 blocks of 128 threads, twenty groups of four elements per thread, unchanged four-wave descending XOR reduction and 16-byte LDS partials. Only SmallGemm original F16 n=1,m=320,k=10240 dispatch is affected.
